question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summery: DNA, discovered by Friedrich Miescher in 1869, is an acid in living cells that contains genetic information. British scientists discovered its structure in 1953 and were awarded the Nobel Prize for Medicine in 1962. In 1986, DNA tests were used by the police to match DNA left by a criminal at the crime scene.
